note: The vocabulary is fixed. Extend it only through the add-design-tool skill. A skill routes by capability and names a tool only as an example.

capabilities.image-gen: Generate a new raster image from text or from reference images.
capabilities.image-edit: Change an existing raster image: crop, retouch, remove a background, expand, upscale.
capabilities.vector: Create or convert vector artwork (SVG): marks, icons, illustrations.
capabilities.video-gen: Generate video footage from text, an image or a reference clip.
capabilities.video-compose: Assemble a video from code, scenes, clips, type and audio, then render it.
capabilities.avatar-video: Produce a talking-head or presenter video from a script.
capabilities.audio: Generate or edit speech, music or sound effects, or transcribe audio.
capabilities.3d-gen: Generate, texture or remesh a 3D model.
capabilities.3d-scene: Compose, light and deliver a 3D scene, or place a model in a page.
capabilities.fabricate: Make a model ready for a physical machine: check a mesh for printing, repair it, slice it into a printer job, or prepare a cut or stitch file.
capabilities.motion: Author interface motion or animated effects in code.
capabilities.ui-components: Find, read or adapt interface components and blocks.
capabilities.templates: Start from a ready layout, page or document template.
capabilities.fonts: Search, recommend, preview, pair or license typefaces.
capabilities.logo-search: Look up an existing brand logo or mark for reference or attribution.
capabilities.critique: Review a design against rules and return findings.
capabilities.canvas: Lay out a fixed-size composition: a board, a poster, a mockup, a page.
capabilities.whiteboard: Sketch freely on a board: flows, notes, rough layouts.
capabilities.diagram: Draw a structured diagram from a text description.
capabilities.moodboard: Collect and arrange references into comparable direction boards.
capabilities.design-system: Create, read or apply a token set and its component rules.
capabilities.dataviz: Build a chart, a data view or a dashboard from data.
capabilities.maps: Build or style a geographic map.
capabilities.asset-library: Search and fetch stored assets: images, icons, models, prompts, brand files.
capabilities.reverse-engineer: Study a reference site or app for structure and technique.
capabilities.capture: Take a screenshot or a recording of a rendered result.
capabilities.deploy: Publish a site or an app to a host.
capabilities.design-to-code: Turn a design file or a frame into code.
capabilities.code-to-design: Turn code or a rendered page into an editable design file.
capabilities.brand-kit: Read or apply a stored brand kit: logo, palette, type, voice.

brand.note: A full brand runs the new-brand flow in ask-gdh: design-brief, mood-board, logo-identity, typography, color, design-system.

fabrication.note: A part or object made on a 3D printer: functional fits, decorative forms, or both. print-design owns the path from concept to a checked, sliced job file. three-d owns 3D on screens.
